decision_point.description: The first damage cue arrives while loot interaction is open.

observed: The player is attacked while vulnerable during loot interaction.
The player returns fire and the engagement has a visible outcome.
inferred: Canceling the interaction and reaching nearby cover would likely preserve more control.
unknown: Enemy intent and any unseen teammate position are not established.
what_helped: The player responds to the close threat instead of remaining in the loot screen.
what_hurt: The loot interaction leaves the player exposed at the start of the forced fight.

realistic_alternative.action: Cancel the loot screen, move behind the nearest visible doorframe or cabinet, and solve the closest shooter first.
realistic_alternative.tradeoff: The items wait while the player gives up a stationary interaction.
realistic_alternative.likely_benefit: This could preserve health and keep a safer route toward extraction.
unknowns: The alternative cannot guarantee a win against an unseen second angle.

next_game_cue: Loot can wait; cover and aim cannot.

drill.name: Loot-cancel drill
drill.trigger: Any shot, damage cue, or close enemy sound during an interaction.
drill.action: Exit the interface and move to the nearest visible cover before healing or returning to loot.
drill.success_condition: Complete the cancel-and-cover action within one second in three forced contacts.
